reserveReview.rationale: Re-fetched fixed-block reads at Ethereum block 26095806 (2026-10-01T06:54:35Z) identify USDS and sUSDS as the Foreign Bridge's collateral tokens. The bridge holds 823,108.741077534044999388 liquid USDS and 48,331,262.650941988724367273 sUSDS shares, with maxWithdraw returning 53,711,261.055768077689618397 USDS. Normalizing liquid USDS and max-withdrawable sUSDS value gives 1.51% USDS and 98.49% sUSDS, rounded to two decimals; 0.052688189469517749 legacy DAI and zero sDAI remain immaterial dust. Gnosis block 48529298 (2026-10-01T06:54:40Z) records 1,337,958,897.531459019251049888 bridge-minted xDAI and 1,283,840,434.163870179025493045 burned, leaving 54,118,463.367588840225556843 outstanding. These on-chain observations do not constitute an independent attestation. Keep both escrow collateral rows visible; underlying USDS/sUSDS mint risk belongs to those assets rather than xDAI native mint authority.
